data.body:
[P2] Apply the lifecycle fence before draining admission exemptions

Both `requireOperationAdmission()` and `requireTaskAdmission()` can return before reaching this check while draining. An already-running child therefore remains able to register descendants after cancellation. For example, if its cleanup enters a replayed pending wait after the final cancellation broadcast, the new operation misses `stopAllOperations()`, polling cannot advance it, and the child blocks indefinitely—preventing invocation cleanup from returning. Check invocation admission before both draining exemptions, preserving descendant admission during ordinary graceful cleanup. Add a regression covering a child that attempts a replayed pending operation after cancellation.
